title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah addresses Ramoji Excellence Awards Ceremony – 2026 in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
subtitle:
Only a few individuals, like Ramoji Rao, transform themselves into institutions during their lifetime; their contributions continue to inspire the nation forever
Ramoji Rao was well-informed about developments from every corner of country, and his views on resolving every problem were clear, forthright and fearless
Born into a poor farming family, Ramoji Rao launched 'Eenadu' without any backing and ensured that first voice of morning reaching every Telugu household was voice of truth
Ramoji Rao kept pace with technological advancements in every era, built the ETV network in Telugu and several other Indian languages, and took television channels to mobile platforms as well
Many people struggle to build their careers, but it is those who struggle to uphold values who truly become great, Shri Ramoji Rao not only fought for values but also established them
Padma Vibhushan was not merely an honour for Ramoji Rao; it was a recognition of journalism, literature and Telugu identity, through his enterprise, he built an institution that continues to uphold his values even in his absence
He did not run newspapers and news channels merely for profit, despite financial losses and immense pressure, he upheld journalism as fourth pillar of democracy
He also made immense contributions to film industry, it is difficult to imagine a film studio for any regional-language film industry without Ramoji Film City
Under the leadership of Shri Narendra Modi, country has witnessed decisive leadership after a long time, with era of policy paralysis giving way to the politics of performance
World's longest and most powerful hydrogen-powered train has been developed in India using entirely indigenous technology and has also begun running on tracks
Under the leadership of Shri Narendra Modi, 98% of Gram Panchayats have been connected through 4G connectivity, and 50 crore Indians have come out of poverty over the past 12 years—a fact also acknowledged by the World Bank
Andhra Pradesh will emerge as most developed state in the country over next 10 years
USD 15 billion AI hub being developed by Google in Visakhapatnam will be its largest hub outside the United States, which is a matter of pride for the entire country
Shri Chandrababu Naidu has successfully translated investments worth ₹30 lakh crore into reality on the ground in just two and a half years, which is a matter of great pride
body_text: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today addressed the Ramoji Excellence Awards Ceremony – 2026 in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. On the occasion, Governor of Andhra Pradesh Shri S. Abdul Nazeer, Chief Minister Shri Chandrababu Naidu, Union Ministers Shri G. Kishan Reddy and Shri K. Ram Mohan Naidu, Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh Shri K. Pawan Kalyan, and several other dignitaries were present. Addressing the award ceremony, Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that today marks the 90 th birth anniversary of Ramoji Rao, who is no longer among us. He said that there are individuals who, through their dedicated work during their lifetime, evolve into institutions, and the institutions they establish continue to inspire the nation forever. Shri Shah said that he had met Ramoji Rao on four occasions and he remained well-informed about developments from every corner of the country. He had a clear understanding of every problem facing the nation and its possible solutions. He held firm convictions of his own and had the courage to express them fearlessly and candidly. He said that Ramoji Rao had an excellent understanding of ground realities. He said that Ramoji Rao continues to serve as a role model for young people in several fields, including agriculture, education, filmmaking and media. Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that Ramoji Rao had an in-depth understanding of the geographical situation, population, challenges and root causes of insurgency in the Northeast. Shri Amit Shah said more he came to know about Ramoji Rao, the greater his respect for him became. Shri Amit Shah said that when one looks back at the 90-year life of Ramoji Rao, it becomes evident that hardly anyone else could have made such an extensive contribution to the nation across so many fields. He said that Ramoji Rao was born into a poor family in Krishna district and had no inheritance, resources or formal degree in journalism. However, he possessed vision in his eyes and mind, along with unwavering determination. Shri Shah said that by launching the newspaper Eenadu , Ramoji Rao sought to make the voice of truth resonate among readers. He said that if Ramoji Rao's contribution were to be assessed today, it could be said that in the world of journalism, the only media group chairman with whom he could be compared was Ram Nath Goenka. Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that Ramoji Rao always kept pace with changing times and evolving technology. He said that when private news channels were first introduced, no one other than Ramoji Rao could have envisioned the possibility of running 24-hour news channels in regional languages. Shri Shah said that Ramoji Rao launched ETV not only in Telugu but also in almost all the regional languages of the country. He added that Ramoji Rao not only enriched the country's regional languages but also took the innovative initiative of making the voice of truth resonate among people across the country through the ETV network. Shri Amit Shah said that on one occasion, when he asked Ramoji Rao what he wished to accomplish with the time he had left, the latter had replied that he wanted to launch a TV channel on mobile phones. He said that today, his mobile channels are available in all languages. It is this passion to keep contributing and the zeal to constantly strive and overcome challenges that make Ramoji Rao truly great. Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that when we look at the owners of today's newspapers and news channels, their business objectives and their focus on profits, we realise what a towering personality Ramoji Rao was. Shri Shah said that Ramoji Rao must have firmly believed that journalism, in its true sense, constitutes the fourth pillar of democracy. He made numerous sacrifices and faced many struggles throughout his life to uphold this conviction. Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that Ramoji Rao spent two major phases of his life in struggle. Despite significant financial losses and numerous challenges, he maintained the impartiality of his news channel and upheld its role as a true fourth pillar of democracy. Shri Shah said that those who struggle to build their careers are also great individuals. Struggle is a unique quality that makes a person great. However, those who struggle to uphold values are even greater. Ramoji Rao always fought for values and worked to establish them. Shri Amit Shah said that when Ramoji Rao was conferred the Padma Vibhushan in 2016, a renowned Gujarati newspaper from Gujarat had written that the honour was not merely a recognition of Ramoji Rao, but also an honour for journalism, literature, education and Telugu pride. Shri Shah said that Ramoji Rao had not merely built a news industry; he had created institutions rather than businesses. Institutions are those that continue to function and uphold the same values even after their founders are no longer present. Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that Ramoji Rao also made significant contributions to the film industry. He said that it is difficult to imagine the film industry of any language without Ramoji Film City. Shri Shah said that Ramoji Rao assured filmmakers that if they came with the funds and their creative vision, everything else would be available at his studio, and they would not need to go anywhere else. Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that several individuals have been selected for the Excellence Awards this year. People who have made significant contributions to the nation in fields such as science and technology, young icons, service to humanity, art and culture, education, medicine and healthcare, rural development, journalism and women's achievements are being honoured on this occasion. He said that he would like to tell all nine award recipients, who are being recognised for their contributions in these nine fields crucial to the country's development, that they may receive many more awards in their lives, but an award associated with the name of Ramoji Rao holds a special significance of its own. Shri Amit Shah said that under the able leadership of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, India is moving forward on the path of progress. He said that over the past 13 years, the country has witnessed stability, continuity and decisive leadership after a long period. The era when policy paralysis was widely discussed has now given way to performance-driven politics and development based on sound policies. Union Home Minister said that significant progress has been made in several areas, including the abrogation of Article 370, ending the five-decade-old problem of Naxalism, driving the country's economic growth and ensuring national security. He said that under the leadership of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, India's economy is advancing rapidly, while opportunities are expanding at an equally fast pace across all sectors. Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that despite the prolonged wars between Russia and Ukraine, and between the United States and other countries, positive projections have emerged regarding India's economic growth.  Moody’s has recently raised its growth forecast for India for 2026–27 from 6.5% to 7%. In 2025–26, India recorded exports worth a record USD 863 billion, and our next target is USD 1 trillion. He expressed confidence that we would achieve this target. Shri Shah said that India has become the world's second-largest producer in the manufacturing sector. India now produces more steel than the United States and Japan combined. This achievement has been accomplished over the past 12 years. He further said that earlier, only 58 Gram Panchayats had internet connectivity, whereas today, 2 lakh 15 thousands Gram Panchayats have been connected through 4G services, accounting for approximately 98 per cent of the total Gram Panchayats. Shri Amit Shah said that India has made significant progress in the economic sector as well. The world's longest and highest-capacity hydrogen train has been built in India using completely indigenous technology, and its operations have also commenced. He said that in 2014, the country had only 76 airports, whereas today, India has made significant strides, with the number of airports reaching 150. Shri Shah further said that, according to a World Bank report, during the 12 years of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi's tenure, 50 crore Indians have come out of poverty, which is a matter of great satisfaction for everyone. Union Home Minister said that for nearly 40 years, the country witnessed more than 2,000 Naxal attacks every year. However, today, it is a matter of satisfaction that not a single Naxal attack is taking place. He said that this is a collective achievement of all of us. He said that Andhra Pradesh, too, is progressing rapidly under the leadership of Shri Chandrababu Naidu. He added that he has been consistently studying the data from Shri Chandrababu Naidu's second term in office and can confidently say that Andhra Pradesh will become the most developed state in the country over the next 10 years. Shri Shah said that Google's USD 15 billion AI hub is a matter of pride not only for Andhra Pradesh but also for the entire country. The establishment of a USD 15 billion AI hub by Google in Visakhapatnam is a matter of pride for the people of India as well as Andhra Pradesh. Both the one-gigawatt data centre and Google's largest AI hub outside the United States are significant achievements for the country. A new gateway for undersea cables will also be established in Andhra Pradesh. He said that the foundation stone of the state's first semiconductor unit has been laid, and major steel plants have been established. Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has recently inaugurated the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, and on the same day, foundation stones were laid for projects worth ₹18,000 crore. Shri Shah said that a closer examination of all these initiatives reveals that Shri Chandrababu Naidu has facilitated the grounding of investments worth ₹30 lakh crore in Andhra Pradesh in just two-and-a-half years. Shri Amit Shah said that once the Polavaram Dam is completed and water reaches every part of Andhra Pradesh, it will create an unparalleled opportunity for the farmers of the state. He said that taking the project forward with firm determination and a time-bound approach is a significant achievement. **** RK/RR/PR/PS
